messages:
Theo (Support): Orion AI reports an unexpected overage on invoice INV-2026-0457. They say an outage caused retries and they were charged extra for the retries. Attached: logs + invoice link. https://console.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0457

Theo (Support): Customer requests a refund for retry-driven overage; estimates ~$1,120.

Marta (BillingOps): Pulling invoice. INV-2026-0457 total: $9,340. Line items show retry charges: retry-ops: $1,120. No credits applied.

BillingBot (system): Incident correlation:
- Infra incident INC-2987 caused request retries 2026-09-14 02:10-02:25 UTC
- Retry billing events: RB-7712 mapped to INV-2026-0457
- Note: system does not auto-exempt retry billing for infra-attributed outages

Jules (Finance): Policy: for provider-side outages we typically offer a goodwill credit for retry charges if customer requests within 30 days. Approve manual credit for $1,120 under GL-4105?

Ibrahim (Sales): Orion is in active renewal talks; recommend full credit to avoid churn. Sales will absorb via customer success budget.

Jules (Finance): Agreed. Approve $1,120 credit. BillingOps to run adjustment and include accounting note referencing INC-2987.

Marta (BillingOps): Suggested command:
redwood-bill adjust --cust OR-662 --invoice INV-2026-0457 --amount -1120 --type credit --gl GL-4105 --note "Goodwill credit for retry charges during INC-2987 outage; RB-7712"

BillingBot (system): Simulation: new invoice total after -$1,120 = $8,220. Adjustment will generate ADJ-37290.

Marta (BillingOps): Executing now (ops user) at 1781457200. Adjustment ID ADJ-37290. Updated invoice: https://console.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0457/adjusted/ADJ-37290.pdf

Jules (Finance): Confirmed ADJ-37290 and created ACCT-8124 for month-end reconciliation. Please attach logs and link to renewal note.

Ibrahim (Sales): Notified customer with apology and confirmation of $1,120 credit; offered a one-time 10% discount on next month's invoice. Customer responded appreciative.

Theo (Support): Linking ADJ-37290 and INC-2987 to the support ticket. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
